detected_defects.description: The driver for the mouthFunnel shape key is incorrectly targeted to the eyeBlink_R bone instead of the mouthFunnel bone.
detected_defects.likely_root_cause: Driver variable configuration error during rig setup.

suggested_repairs: Open the driver for FaceMesh key_blocks["mouthFunnel"].value and update its variable target from pose.bones["eyeBlink_R"] to pose.bones["mouthFunnel"].
